content.title: 2026 Masters Tee Times Friday: When do players start second round?
content.text: Updated April 10, 2026, 10:31 a.m. ETThe 90th Masters Tournament opens Round 2 on Friday, April 10, and here are the tee times released earlier in the week by Augusta National Golf Club for first-round groupings.The field will go off in sets of three (with two pairs of two) on the first two days of the tournament. Each group will play a morning round on one day and an afternoon round on the other. Players are in the same group on the first two days.Traditionally, the defending Masters champion plays with the reigning U.S. Amateur champion, and that will be the case again in 2026 for Rory McIlroy and Mason Howell.Here's a look at the full list of tee times, as well as some high-powered groupings patrons and fans online will be watching.
